item.title: Youth and Community Development — Procurement: Legal Services to Immigrants NAQ
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
Non-competitive NAQ for Youth Ministries for Peace and Justice (YMPJ). LSNY Bronx is no longer able to provide Legal Services for Immigrants. This contractor is to assist immigrants, including immigrant youths, survivors of domestic violence and trafficking as well as non-citizen, immigrant workers, in attaining lawful immigration status by providing legal counseling, application assistance, and legal representation to address immigrants social services needs directly or through referrals, and provide related legal services. These services are critical to New Yorkers.
